facts.name: Rate Variation by Age Band
facts.sentence: Monthly rates vary by 5-year age bands.

facts.name: Annual Rate Publication
facts.sentence: The current rate schedule is published annually.

facts.name: Current Rate Schedule Reference
facts.sentence: The current rate schedule is attached as Schedule 1.

facts.name: Maximum Member Benefit Limit
facts.sentence: The maximum member benefit is $750,000.

facts.name: Maximum Member Benefit Tier
facts.sentence: The maximum member benefit corresponds to Tier 5.

facts.name: Spouse Coverage Amounts
facts.sentence: Spouse coverage is available in a flat amount of $25,000.

facts.name: Spouse Coverage Amounts
facts.sentence: Spouse coverage is also available in a flat amount of $50,000.

facts.name: Spouse Coverage Limit
facts.sentence: Spouse coverage may not exceed 50% of the member’s coverage in force.

facts.name: New Enrollment Without EOI Limit
facts.sentence: Any new enrollment without EOI is limited to Tiers 1–4.

facts.name: Tiers 1–4 Coverage Limits
facts.sentence: Tiers 1–4 provide benefits up to $500,000.

facts.name: Tier 5 EOI Requirement
facts.sentence: Tier 5, which provides $750,000 in coverage, always requires EOI.

facts.name: Post-60-Day Enrollment Requirement
facts.sentence: Any enrollment occurring outside the 60-day new-member window requires EOI.

facts.name: Enrollment Outside Open Enrollment Requires EOI
facts.sentence: Any enrollment occurring outside the annual open enrollment period requires EOI.

facts.name: Tier 5 Cost
facts.sentence: Tier 5 coverage costs $750,000.

facts.name: Tier 5 EOI Requirement
facts.sentence: Tier 5 coverage always requires an Expression of Interest (EOI).

facts.name: Enrollment Outside 60-Day Window Requires EOI
facts.sentence: Any enrollment occurring outside the 60-day new-member window requires an Expression of Interest (EOI).

facts.name: Enrollment Outside Open Enrollment Requires EOI
facts.sentence: Any enrollment occurring outside the annual open enrollment period requires an Expression of Interest (EOI).

facts.name: Age-Band Rate Determination
facts.sentence: Policy rates are determined using age bands.

facts.name: Annual Rate Recalculation
facts.sentence: Rates are recalculated annually at each policy anniversary when a member enters a new 5-year age band.

facts.name: Rate Increase Notification
facts.sentence: Cornerstone provides 90 days’ advance notice prior to any rate increase affecting an existing tier.

facts.name: Membership Requirement for Coverage
facts.sentence: Coverage remains in force as long as NAIFA membership is maintained in good standing.

facts.name: Premium Payment Requirement
facts.sentence: Coverage remains in force as long as monthly premiums are paid when due.

facts.name: Voluntary Cancellation Termination
facts.sentence: Coverage terminates immediately upon voluntary cancellation by the member.

facts.name: Membership Lapse Termination
facts.sentence: Coverage terminates immediately upon lapse or revocation of NAIFA membership.

facts.name: Non-Payment Termination with Grace Period
facts.sentence: Coverage terminates immediately upon non-payment of premium, subject to the grace period.

facts.name: Age 80 Coverage Limit
facts.sentence: Coverage is not available beyond age 80.

facts.name: Death Termination Clause
facts.sentence: Coverage terminates immediately upon death of the member.

facts.name: Grace Period for Premium Payments
facts.sentence: A 31-day grace period applies to monthly premiums.

facts.name: Grace Period Continuity Rule
facts.sentence: If a premium is received within the 31-day grace period, coverage is considered continuous.

facts.name: Grace Period Death Coverage
facts.sentence: Death occurring during the grace period is covered.

facts.name: Age 75 Benefit Reduction
facts.sentence: At the policy anniversary following the member’s 75th birthday, coverage automatically reduces to 50% of the elected tier benefit.

facts.name: Conversion Rights After Membership Lapse
facts.sentence: If coverage terminates due to lapse of NAIFA membership, the member may convert to an individual whole-life or term policy.

facts.name: Master Policy Cancellation Conversion Right
facts.sentence: If coverage terminates due to cancellation of the master policy, the member may convert to an individual whole-life or term policy.

facts.name: Conversion Window After Termination
facts.sentence: Conversion to an individual policy can occur within 31 days of termination of coverage.

facts.name: No EOI for Membership Lapse Conversion
facts.sentence: Conversion does not require an Expression of Interest (EOI) if termination results from lapse of NAIFA membership.

facts.name: No EOI for Master Policy Cancellation
facts.sentence: Conversion does not require an Expression of Interest (EOI) if termination results from cancellation of the master policy.

facts.name: Non-Payment Conversion Restriction
facts.sentence: Conversion is not available if coverage terminates due to non-payment of premium.

facts.name: Conversion Not Available on Cancellation
facts.sentence: Conversion is not available if coverage terminates due to member-requested cancellation.

facts.name: Maximum Conversion Limit
facts.sentence: The maximum amount eligible for conversion is $250,000.

facts.name: Maximum Conversion Limit
facts.sentence: The maximum amount eligible for conversion is the lesser of $250,000 or the member's current coverage in force.

facts.name: Non-Employer-Sponsored Coverage
facts.sentence: This coverage is not employer-sponsored.

facts.name: No Portability for Non-Employer Plans
facts.sentence: Conventional portability provisions do not apply to this coverage.

facts.name: NAIFA Membership Requirement
facts.sentence: Membership in NAIFA is the sole condition for continued coverage.

facts.name: Non-Employer-Sponsored Policy
facts.sentence: This policy is not employer-sponsored.

facts.name: No Conventional Portability
facts.sentence: Conventional portability provisions do not apply to this policy.

facts.name: Membership-Based Coverage Continuity
facts.sentence: Membership is the sole condition for continued coverage.

facts.name: Acceleration Benefit Limit
facts.sentence: A member can request acceleration of up to 60% of the member benefit.

facts.name: Maximum Acceleration Limit
facts.sentence: The maximum amount available through acceleration is $300,000.

facts.name: Terminal Condition Eligibility
facts.sentence: Acceleration is only available to members diagnosed with a terminal condition.

facts.name: Terminal Condition Diagnosis Requirement
facts.sentence: Two independent licensed physicians must diagnose a terminal condition.

facts.name: Life Expectancy Requirement
facts.sentence: Life expectancy must be certified as 18 months or less for acceleration eligibility.

facts.name: Actuarial Discount Application
facts.sentence: Cornerstone applies an actuarial discount when calculating accelerated payments.

facts.name: Actuarial Discount Based on Age
facts.sentence: The actuarial discount is based on the member's current age.

facts.name: Actuarial Discount Factors
facts.sentence: The actuarial discount is also based on the member's anticipated life expectancy.

facts.name: Spouse Acceleration Ineligibility
facts.sentence: Spouse coverage is not eligible for acceleration.

facts.name: Suicide Benefit Exclusion
facts.sentence: No death benefit is payable for suicide occurring within 24 months of the effective date of any new or increased coverage.

facts.name: Suicide Benefit Eligibility Post-24 Months
facts.sentence: For coverage amounts in force for more than 24 months, the full death benefit is payable for suicide.

facts.name: Incontestability Clause
facts.sentence: After 2 years from the effective date of any coverage amount, Cornerstone cannot contest a claim due to misrepresentation.

facts.name: Fraud Exception to Incontestability
facts.sentence: Cornerstone retains the right to contest a claim based on fraudulent misrepresentation even after 2 years.

facts.name: No Pre-Existing Condition Exclusion
facts.sentence: There is no exclusion for pre-existing conditions in this policy.

facts.name: No Occupation Exclusion
facts.sentence: There is no exclusion for occupation in this policy.

facts.name: No Foreign Travel Exclusion
facts.sentence: There is no exclusion for foreign travel in this policy.

facts.name: Aviation Exclusion Exception
facts.sentence: Aviation is excluded unless the individual is a crew member of a non-commercial aircraft operating outside the U.S.

facts.name: Foreign Death Documentation Requirement
facts.sentence: Claims arising from death outside the United States require an authenticated death certificate.

facts.name: Consular Report Requirement
facts.sentence: If applicable, a U.S. consular report of death is required for foreign death claims.

facts.name: Foreign Death Claim Review Period
facts.sentence: A 90-day supplemental review period applies to foreign death claims.

facts.name: Premium Waiver for Disability
facts.sentence: Premiums are waived if the member becomes totally disabled before age 65.

facts.name: Premium Waiver Timing
facts.sentence: The premium waiver begins after a 6-month elimination period.

facts.name: Premium Waiver During Disability
facts.sentence: Premium waivers continue as long as the disability persists.

facts.name: Premium Waiver for Disability
facts.sentence: If a member becomes totally disabled before age 65, premiums are waived.

facts.name: Premium Waiver Start Timing
facts.sentence: The waiver of premiums begins after a 6-month elimination period.

facts.name: Waiver Duration During Disability
facts.sentence: Premiums remain waived while the disability continues.

facts.name: Definition of Total Disability
facts.sentence: Total disability means complete inability to engage in any gainful occupation for which the member is reasonably suited.

facts.name: No own-occupation standard
facts.sentence: The own-occupation standard does not apply to determine total disability.

facts.name: Premium Waiver Limitation
facts.sentence: Waiver of premium is available only for member coverage.

facts.name: Spouse Premium Not Waived
facts.sentence: Spouse coverage premiums are not waived during disability.

facts.name: Premium Waiver Termination at Age 65
facts.sentence: Waiver of premium terminates at age 65.

facts.name: Premium Waiver Termination on Recovery
facts.sentence: Waiver of premium terminates upon recovery from disability.

facts.name: Waiver Termination Condition
facts.sentence: The earlier event between age 65 and recovery determines when the waiver ends.

facts.name: Beneficiary Designation Process
facts.sentence: Members may designate beneficiaries via NAIFA's online member portal.

facts.name: Beneficiary Change Effective Upon Submission
facts.sentence: Beneficiary changes become effective upon submission.

facts.name: Spouse Coverage Beneficiary Rule
facts.sentence: For spouse coverage, the designated beneficiary is the member.

facts.name: Spouse Benefit Inheritance Rule
facts.sentence: If the member predeceases the covered spouse, the spouse’s estate receives the spouse benefit.

facts.name: Claim Submission Deadline
facts.sentence: Claims must be submitted within 12 months of death.

facts.name: Claim Documentation Requirement
facts.sentence: A certified death certificate is required to submit a claim.

facts.name: Claim Submission Requirement
facts.sentence: A completed claim form is required to submit a claim.

facts.name: Claim Documentation Requirement
facts.sentence: Proof of beneficiary identity is required to submit a claim.

facts.name: Claim Submission Address
facts.sentence: Claims should be submitted to Cornerstone National Life – Association Claims.

facts.name: Claims Mailing Address
facts.sentence: The mailing address for claims submissions is 2200 Insurance Row, Minneapolis, MN 55402.

facts.name: Claims Contact Number
facts.sentence: The phone number for claims inquiries is 1-866-555-0044.

facts.name: Claims Submission Email
facts.sentence: The email address for claims submissions is assocclaims@cornerstonell.com.

facts.name: Claim Payment Timeline
facts.sentence: Payment is issued within 10 business days of receiving complete documentation.

facts.name: Governing Law Jurisdiction
facts.sentence: This insurance certificate is governed by the laws of the State of Minnesota.

facts.name: Binding Arbitration Clause
facts.sentence: Disputes related to this certificate are subject to binding arbitration.

facts.name: Dispute Resolution via AAA Arbitration
facts.sentence: Arbitration follows the AAA Commercial Arbitration Rules.

facts.name: Company Headquarters Location
facts.sentence: Cornerstone National Life Insurance Company is headquartered in Minneapolis, Minnesota.

facts.name: Presidential Authorization
facts.sentence: The President of the Association Products Division signed this certificate.

facts.name: Certificate Issuance Date
facts.sentence: This certificate was issued on July 1, 2024.
